lesson.title: Plans, Changes & Keeping Going
lesson.subtitle: Planning, discovering, exchanging, completing, and persisting
lesson.description: Talk about making plans, discovering things, changing or exchanging, borrowing and returning, and completing goals.

learning_objectives: Talk about intentions, persistence, and completion: 打算, 试, 选, 坚持, 完成, and 忘记.
Describe change and discovery: 变, 变成, 换, 加, 长, 不见, and 发现.
Talk about borrowing, receiving, and returning: 借, 还, 收, 得, 得到, 参加, and 照.

metadata.audience: HSK 3.0 Level 3 learners with Level 1-2 foundations

overview.topic_description: Verbs of planning, transformation, exchange, and accomplishment.
overview.focus: Note the two pronunciations of 还 (huán "return" vs. hái "still") and 变成 ("turn into").

dialogue.title: Changing Plans and Keeping Going
dialogue.context_en: Two friends talk about a photography contest and returning a borrowed camera.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 我把上次借你的相机带来还给你了！
turns.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ shàng cì jiè nǐ de xiàngjī dài lái huán gěi nǐ le!
turns.english: I brought back the camera I borrowed from you last time to return it!

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 谢谢！对了，你打算参加下个月的摄影比赛吗？
turns.pinyin: Xièxie! Duìle, nǐ dǎsuàn cānjiā xià ge yuè de shèyǐng bǐsài ma?
turns.english: Thanks! By the way, do you plan to join next month’s photography contest?

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 想试试！我选了几张照片，可总觉得还不够好，打算再换两张。
turns.pinyin: Xiǎng shìshi! Wǒ xuǎn le jǐ zhāng zhàopiàn, kě zǒng juéde hái búgòu hǎo, dǎsuàn zài huàn liǎng zhāng.
turns.english: I want to try! I picked a few photos, but feel they’re not good enough yet, so I plan to swap two.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 只要坚持练习，你一定能完成目标，得到好成绩！
turns.pinyin: Zhǐyào jiānchí liànxí, nǐ yídìng néng wánchéng mùbiāo, dédào hǎo chéngjì!
turns.english: As long as you keep practicing, you’ll definitely reach your goal and get a good result!

patterns.title: Turning into something with 变成
patterns.explanation_en: Use 变成 (biànchéng) + noun to express changing from one state or thing into another.

examples.hanzi: 几年没见，那个小男孩长成大高个儿了，家乡也变成了一座现代城市。
examples.pinyin: Jǐ nián méi jiàn, nàge xiǎo nánhái zhǎng chéng dà gāogèr le, jiāxiāng yě biànchéng le yí zuò xiàndài chéngshì.
examples.english: Haven’t seen him in years—that little boy grew tall, and our hometown has turned into a modern city.

examples.hanzi: 水在零度以下会变成冰。
examples.pinyin: Shuǐ zài líng dù yǐxià huì biànchéng bīng.
examples.english: Water turns into ice below zero degrees.

patterns.title: Borrowing and returning with 借 / 还
patterns.explanation_en: 借 (jiè) can mean borrow (向……借) or lend (借给……); 还 (huán) means return (还给……).
patterns.pattern_hanzi: 向 + <Person> + 借 + <Item>  /  把 + <Item> + 还给 + <Person>

examples.hanzi: 我向同学借了一本词典。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiàng tóngxué jiè le yì běn cídiǎn.
examples.english: I borrowed a dictionary from my classmate.

examples.hanzi: 看完以后，请按时把书还给图书馆。
examples.pinyin: Kàn wán yǐhòu, qǐng ànshí bǎ shū huán gěi túshūguǎn.
examples.english: After reading, please return the book to the library on time.

guided_building.instruction_en: Express plans, discoveries, and completing tasks.

model_answer.pinyin: Zhè xuéqī wǒ dǎsuàn shì zhe xué yí xiàng xīn yùndòng.

substitutions.cue_en: Say the weather has changed much cooler.

model_answer.hanzi: 天气变凉快了，该加件衣服了。

model_answer.english: The weather has turned cooler; it’s time to add a layer of clothes.

paragraphs.hanzi: 去年秋天，小张打算每天坚持跑三公里。刚开始的时候，他觉得很累，好几次都想放弃，甚至差点儿忘记自己的计划。
paragraphs.pinyin: Qùnián qiūtiān, Xiǎo Zhāng dǎsuàn měitiān jiānchí pǎo sān gōnglǐ. Gāng kāishǐ de shíhou, tā juéde hěn lèi, hǎo jǐ cì dōu xiǎng fàngqì, shènzhì chàdiǎnr wàngjì zìjǐ de jìhuà.
paragraphs.english: Last autumn, Xiao Zhang planned to stick to running three kilometers every day. At the start he felt very tired, wanted to quit several times, and even nearly forgot his plan.

paragraphs.hanzi: 后来他选了一条经过公园的路线，一边跑一边看风景。半年以后，他发现自己不仅完成了目标，身体也变得更健康了。
paragraphs.pinyin: Hòulái tā xuǎn le yì tiáo jīngguò gōngyuán de lùxiàn, yìbiān pǎo yìbiān kàn fēngjǐng. Bàn nián yǐhòu, tā fāxiàn zìjǐ bùjǐn wánchéng le mùbiāo, shēntǐ yě biàn de gèng jiànkāng le.
paragraphs.english: Later he chose a route passing through a park, enjoying the scenery while running. Half a year later, he discovered he had not only completed his goal, but his body had also become healthier.

questions.prompt_en: What was Xiao Zhang’s plan last autumn?
questions.answer_en: To stick to running three kilometers every day.
He chose a route passing through a park so he could enjoy the scenery while running.

speaking_tasks.scenario_en: Talk about a plan you want to stick to using 打算, 坚持, and 完成.

model_answer.hanzi: 我打算每天复习十个生词，坚持一个月完成这本课本。
model_answer.pinyin: Wǒ dǎsuàn měitiān fùxí shí ge shēngcí, jiānchí yí ge yuè wánchéng zhè běn kèběn.
model_answer.english: I plan to review ten new words every day and keep at it for a month to finish this textbook.

speaking_tasks.scenario_en: Describe a change you noticed recently using 发现 or 变.

model_answer.hanzi: 我发现公园里的树都长高了，草地也变绿了。
model_answer.pinyin: Wǒ fāxiàn gōngyuán lǐ de shù dōu zhǎng gāo le, cǎodì yě biàn lǜ le.
model_answer.english: I noticed the trees in the park have grown taller and the lawn has turned green.

teaching_plan.common_pitfall: 还 has two readings: hái ("still / also") and huán ("return / give back"). In 还书 ("return a book"), always read it huán.
teaching_plan.pronunciation_focus: 发现 (fāxiàn) moves from flat fā to falling xiàn; 坚持 (jiānchí) moves from flat jiān to rising chí.

can_do: Talk about plans, persistence, and completion.
Use 借 and 还 accurately.
